changelog: - **Downloads now say what unit their numbers are in.** When a kind names a base unit, the Timeline CSV and the Monte Carlo CSV and JSON downloads name it: a column reads `Feed tank [m³] [feed]` or `Feed tank [m³]`, and the Monte Carlo series and summary gain a `unit` column. Every number stays a plain number in the base unit. A document that names no unit downloads exactly what it did before.
